title: US-061 Record the gate code of a site
description: Mariia stores the gate code of the site on the installation, readable by the crews and set by the planners. The crew leads tested it and signed it off: this is the newest story Lab 3.10 promotes, and it touches the same layout as US-060 without conflicting with it.
commitMessage:
US-061 Record the gate code of a site

Installation__c.Gate_Code__c, on the layout under the account, readable
by Helios_Delivery_Crew and editable by Helios_Delivery_Manager.
prTitle: US-061 Record the gate code of a site
prBody:
Crews phone the customer from the gate at seven in the morning to get in.
This puts the code on the installation, where the planner already has it.

- New field `Installation__c.Gate_Code__c`
- On the Installation layout, after Account
- `Helios_Delivery_Crew`: read
- `Helios_Delivery_Manager`: read and edit

Story: US-061 in BACKLOG.md
nextStep: Review it and merge it into integration: it is the last of the five. Then promote integration into uat, Lab 3.10 step 2.
